question_or_proposition: For the Pimephales promelas row in the Whole Effluent Toxicity (7-Day Chronic Static Renewal/NOEC) table, does the VALUE entry 'Report' establish that no enforceable numeric discharge limitation applies in Part I (so that WET results are subject only to monitoring and reporting obligations, with no numeric compliance comparison under Part I), or must 'Report' be read together with Part II conditions referenced in footnote (3) to determine whether an enforceable numeric limit applies?
required_context: Whole Effluent Toxicity Testing table on page 4 (Pimephales promelas row: VALUE, MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY, SAMPLE TYPE columns)
Part II WET testing requirements and additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions referenced in footnote (3)
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, page 4, section part_i, WET table, Pimephales promelas row, VALUE column
notes: The nominated span 'Report' appears in the discharge-limitations VALUE column for a WET species row where monitoring frequency is specified separately. Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from report-only monitoring; Purpose C requires classifying missing or non-numeric WET evidence without treating absence of data as compliance or violation. Resolving what 'Report' establishes about numeric limit applicability would change whether numeric compliance comparison is performed and how absent WET results are categorized.
